redirects.//: /sitemap.xml is the address every crawler, plugin and human tries first, and this build emits /sitemap-index.xml instead. Unredirected it is a 404 on the one URL most likely to be typed by something looking for the sitemap. robots.txt already names the real file; this covers everything that does not read robots.txt.

headers.//: CONTENT-SECURITY-POLICY. Read scripts/verify-csp.mjs before touching the script-src hashes: it recomputes them from dist on every build and fails the build if this line and the shipped HTML disagree, so a hash edited here by hand and nowhere else is caught rather than deployed. WHY HASHES AND NOT 'unsafe-inline': the only two inline scripts on this site are authored in this repository, in src/components/BaseHead.astro and src/components/Header.astro, and both are byte-identical on all 24 pages. WHY style-src KEEPS 'unsafe-inline' WHEN script-src DOES NOT: Astro inlines three @font-face blocks into every head and the templates carry inline style attributes, which no hash can cover because CSP hashes do not apply to style attributes. That is a much smaller exposure than an inline script and the alternative is losing the fonts on a dependency bump. WHY THERE IS NO upgrade-insecure-requests: this build ships zero insecure subresources, so it would buy nothing, and /articles/what-the-whitepaper-cites/ deliberately links two documents that exist ONLY over plain HTTP and is an article about that fact. form-action is 'none' because this site has no form.
